interpretation.numericChange: 605100: skill function 22990 grants actor trait 10006; NP function 23002 reads that trait and adds attackBuff 300 permille. Other default calculator outcomes are unchanged.
interpretation.countScope: Only a single positive buff selector with one known full instance signature is bound. Counts exclude actor intrinsic traits and constant buffs. Special lifetime, partial removal and movement remain typed barriers.
interpretation.candidateBound: For the supported positive NP count gain, ceil(maximum NP capacity / minimum positive value cell) represents all larger initial counts after saturation. All integers through this bound are enumerated; grant and remove-all preserve this equivalence. This is not a cap on the live buff instance state.
interpretation.limitation: This artifact compares canonical data and observed application results; it does not supply the missing in-game HP numerical observations or certify the whole TSK-06.45 Done gate.
